narrative_shape: Census reruns that finish and get committed. Turn 70 waits on a background reference run. Turn 72 starts the remaining continuity and mirror runs. Turn 74 waits on those three. Turn 83 they have finished; sha256 matches across pairs; the worker inspects JSON and builds the evidence file; turn 90 commits owned paths. Edits stay at 6. No reread table. The waits are the measurement plan, and they resolve.

phases.name: staggered census waits
phases.note: One run finishes quickly; three more are launched; Monitor 4. Explicit pauses.

phases.name: identity check and commit
phases.note: Sha256 matches, JSON inspected against the brief, evidence file, commit of owned paths.

early_signals.signal: Pauses for the background reference run.
First run succeeded; starts the continuity and mirror reruns.
Waiting on the remaining three runs.
Those runs finished; next act is sha256 identity and the evidence JSON.

rationale: The early window is the multi-run wait and, inside the same window, the successful identity check and commit. The waits are the measurement, not a stuck poll after the work was done.
